text:
maria_garcia: Quick microbench check — I saw a ~12% regression in token/sec when enabling fused op + flash attention on A100 during the 512 seq long-run. Can someone reproduce? I ran on a dev node with model=llama-7b, seq=512, batch=1.

alex_choi: I'll spin up a run on a100-2 now. sending PR link for the changes I tested: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1423 :eyes:

pranav: Can you paste the exact command/flags you used? Need kernel counters and whether the run used paged-attn or standard flash.

maria_garcia: Command I used:
```
./bench/run_microbench --model=llama-7b --attn=paged+flash --fused-ops=1 --quant=bf16 --batch=1 --seq=512 --warmup=50 --steps=300
```
Note: this was with continuous batching ON (default) and KV cache enabled.

bench-bot: CI job started -> https://ci.redwood.ai/job/microbench/9854 (a100-2)

alex_choi: Run finished. Quick numbers:
```
baseline (no-fused, flash off): 110 tok/s
flash only: 132 tok/s
fused+flash (current PR): 115 tok/s
latency p50: baseline 18ms -> fused+flash 22ms
```
Looks like fused made it worse for this config. Attaching full logs.

sam_k: Hmm. Did you disable continuous batching for the fused run? We had a known interaction where fused ops + batching schedule increases kernel launch overhead.

alex_choi: I left batching ON (same as Maria). I'll re-run with --continuous-batching=0 and with paged-attn toggled.

pranav: Please collect nvprof/CUPTI counters for L2 misses and kernel launch counts. Also record SM occupancy. That should tell if kernel fragmentation is happening.

alex_choi: Re-run queued (a100-2). Will attach perf counters. ETA ~8m.

bench-bot: Perf trace available -> s3://redwood-bench/traces/1759998765-1423-perf.tar.gz

alex_choi: Re-run results:
```
fused+flash, batching off: 140 tok/s
SM occupancy avg: 63%
kernel launches: 14 -> (reduced vs 28)
L2 misses: reduced
```
So disabling continuous batching recovers perf. Looks like fused path is sensitive to batching strategy.

elaine_h: Good find. We should update the rollout matrix to only enable fused ops when continuous batching is disabled OR when seq distribution > 256. Add to PR as a config flag.

maria_garcia: Agree. Also let's add a micro test that runs seq=128,256,512 to check thresholds automatically.

pranav: For the PR: add a perf note and a toggle (runtime config) and ensure the optimizer picks non-fused kernels when batching is on for short sequences.

alex_choi: I'll push updates to the PR and request review from @pranav and @elaine. cc @maria_garcia

maria_garcia: Thanks. Assigning follow-ups:
- alex: update PR with config flag + perf note (by EOD)
- pranav: add nvprof-based regression test (this week)
- elaine: update rollout docs + console flag mapping

maria_garcia: If anyone else can run quick sanity on V100 or T4, would appreciate confirmation that this isn't A100-specific. :thumbsup:

sam_k: I'll run on a T4 tonight and post results.

bench-bot: Reminder: add microbench label 'regression' to PR 1423 -> done.

alex_choi: Pushed changes, link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1423/files — added --enable-fused-kernels flag and perf section in PR description.

pranav: Reviewing now.

elaine_h: Thanks all. Let's reconvene async if more regressions pop up. :rocket:
